02 — About

The cut should be worth the trip.

Blessed Barberhouse is a modern space in Zürich built around one idea. We take the time to understand what you actually want, suggest what will work with your hair, and execute it precisely.

Classic barbering traditions, contemporary style, and an atmosphere that doesn't rush you. Espresso or a craft beer is on us.
